common.driver: analysis/tools/seg.py <name> <start_snapshot|none> "<python body using p>" (analysis/tools/play.py: p.tap(button,hold,after) holds the button(s) for `hold` frames then releases for `after` frames; p.frames(n,buttons) holds buttons for n frames). Trace: trace.configure enabled=true capacity=0 (aggregates only). Budgets: emulator.step unit=frame count<=600 max_operations=100000000 timeout_ms=300000 per call.
